title: eCourts Services — Case Status, Court Orders and Judicial Information

service_context.subject: Online access to court case information and judicial services
service_context.purpose: Provide citizens and other stakeholders with access to case status, court orders and judgments, cause lists and other official eCourts services.
service_context.important_note: eCourts provides court information and services. The AI must not invent case status, interpret an order as legal advice, or claim that information retrieved from eCourts determines the outcome of a case.

cnr_number.description: A case can be searched using its 16-character CNR number. The case status and available case history can then be viewed.

case_number.description: Cases can be searched using the case type, case registration number and registration year.

party_name.description: Cases can be searched using the name of a petitioner, plaintiff, complainant, respondent, defendant, appellant, accused or other party.

advocate.description: Cases can be searched using advocate-related information.

filing_number.description: Cases can be searched using the filing number and filing year.

fir_number.description: Applicable cases can be searched using police station, FIR number and FIR year.

act_and_section.description: Cases can be searched by selecting an Act and, where applicable, entering the relevant section.

case_type.description: Cases can be searched by case type and registration year.

court_orders_and_judgments.case_number_search: Orders or judgments can be searched using the case type, case number and registration year.
court_orders_and_judgments.party_name_search: Orders or judgments can be searched using petitioner or respondent party information and year.
court_orders_and_judgments.order_date_search: Orders or judgments can be searched for a selected date range.
court_orders_and_judgments.document_access: Available orders and judgments can be opened in PDF format through the relevant eCourts service.

cause_lists.description: Users can search cause lists by selecting the relevant court or bench and date.

national_judicial_data_grid.name: National Judicial Data Grid
national_judicial_data_grid.description: NJDG provides searchable case-related information and analytical statistics covering courts across India.
national_judicial_data_grid.important_note: NJDG statistics and case information should be treated as official judicial information and not as predictions of an individual case outcome.

case_information_safety.verification_rule: The AI should rely on official eCourts information when presenting a user's case status or court-order information.
case_information_safety.no_invention_rule: If the required case information cannot be found or verified, the AI must say that it cannot verify the information instead of guessing.
case_information_safety.privacy_rule: The system should avoid unnecessarily exposing sensitive case information and should only process information needed for the user's requested task.
case_information_safety.interpretation_rule: The AI may summarize publicly available case-status information but should not present a legal interpretation of a court order as a substitute for professional legal advice.

rag_use: Explain how a user can check the status of a court case.
Identify appropriate eCourts search methods based on information available to the user.
Guide users toward official court orders and judgments.
Explain the purpose of the CNR number.
Direct users toward official NJDG information and statistics.
Support case-tracking features in Alimony Plus.
Provide official eCourts references when discussing case-status navigation.

application_to_alimony_plus.case_tracking_rule: The application may help users understand how to locate and monitor their court case using official eCourts services.
application_to_alimony_plus.safety_rule: The AI must not claim that a case is pending, disposed, listed or decided unless the relevant official information has been verified.
application_to_alimony_plus.human_review: Questions requiring legal interpretation of a court order, procedural strategy or case-specific legal advice should be referred to an appropriate legal professional.
